highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications relying on implicit font fallback should review the changed fontconfig selection behavior before upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback can select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify the family and style explicitly, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic fallback selection matters.

bullets.detail: Brings the bundled renderer forward to Chrome milestone 153 together with subsequent upstream correctness and buffer-upload fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the m153 line for final validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves the bundled HarfBuzz package's Windows binary-analysis configuration without changing the shaping API.
